eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with UC who are planned for reconstruction with IPAA. All four Swedish units with a national license to perform restorative surgery in IBD will be recruiting patients.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with concomitant primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) or previous intolerance to 5-ASA will be excluded.

identificationModule.briefTitle: ASAPP Study - Topical 5-ASA as Prophylaxis for Pouchitis in Ulcerative Colitis Patients After Pelvic Pouch Surgery
